svg.text: DRC3a Literature Coding v2: Oxygen-System Detail vs Energy-System Detail
Structured from table columns: modality, endpoint, energy source, method, scale, observation window, and causal strength (n=94).
Oxygen-system detail score: modality + endpoint + system scale + time resolution
Energy-system detail score: source + energy endpoint + system scale + time resolution

Scores are weighted components, not citation quality: oxygen = modality 35% + oxygen endpoint 35% + system scale 15% + time 15%;
energy = source 40% + energy endpoint 35% + system scale 10% + time 15%.
